notes: Capsule beacons (author 2026-11-24, memory cockpit-capsule-rescue): automatic radio buoys a crew in an escape capsule can
hear and home on. A beacon broadcasts its position and the rescue service it belongs to; a capsule that hears it learns
that service (its hub) even if it never met it, and when the hub is out of its reach it flies to the beacon itself and
waits there for the pick-up. hear_radius_km: the reach of its broadcast for a capsule's receiver.
anchor: as route_zones.json - hub (runtime hub id) | body | lagrange (primary, secondary, fraction from the primary).
Placed on the surveyed lanes between the inhabited places (memory space-knowledge-and-map: beacons on the routes).
